visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black button-down shirt sits in a black office chair, holding a green snack bag. He gestures with his hands while speaking animatedly. Behind him is a white wall with a yellow three-tiered shelf containing a lighthouse model, the Statue of Liberty, and architectural figurines. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shows a hand placing the green snack bag on top of a black computer chassis. This transitions to a brightly lit laboratory setting where robotic arms are seen processing test tubes in a circular carousel. (3) A stack of industrial signal lights is shown in a close-up, with the green light illuminated. Then, a vintage white delivery truck from 1969 is seen on a street, featuring a large red circular logo with a cartoon character. (4) A hand is shown scrolling through a smartphone screen. A cartoon overlay of a female face with a blank expression appears briefly. A television test pattern with the text '1988' and a static glitch effect is displayed. (5) Several images of snack bag collaborations appear, including one with a Tainan deity character and another for a movie called 'A Chip'. The man returns to the screen, pointing at a mascot graphic and social media contact information.
